name: @graphrefly/native
description: GraphReFly Rust substrate (napi-rs bindings) — preview. Async-surface Rust implementation of the GraphReFly dispatcher (Core runs on a tokio blocking pool; every Core-touching call is async). NOTE: this is NOT (yet) a drop-in substitute for @graphrefly/pure-ts — @graphrefly/graphrefly consumes a sync substrate API; redirecting the peer via npm overrides will not work. A sync/async public-contract reconciliation (D080) is deferred. Use @graphrefly/pure-ts for @graphrefly/graphrefly today.
comment_for_humans: @graphrefly/native is the napi-rs binding for the Rust GraphReFly dispatcher. package.json mirrors the napi-rs canonical layout (binaryName + per-target sub-packages; optionalDependencies are generated by `napi prepublish` in CI, not committed). AUTH = npm OIDC trusted publishing, NO NPM_TOKEN. FIRST PUBLISH is a one-time local bootstrap: run scripts/first-publish-native.sh (interactive `npm login`; cross-builds 5 targets; publishes all 6 packages) then configure the trusted publisher on each package (graphrefly / graphrefly-rs / native-npm-publish.yml). Thereafter `native-v*` tags publish token-free via OIDC (provenance auto). publishConfig.access=public makes the scoped sub-packages public on first publish. Prereq: @graphrefly npm org + an `npm login` for the one-time bootstrap (no CI secret). This preview is the ASYNC Rust substrate; it is NOT a sync drop-in for @graphrefly/pure-ts (D080 reconciliation deferred — see graphrefly-ts archive/docs/SESSION-DS-native-substrate-contract.md).
